canonical.Naya Node: A reusable governed semantic intelligence unit in the source/concept model; distinct from the nine Master Node responsibilities and from the Smart Node human command.
canonical.Intelligent Block: The canonical committed object behind a Smart Note; receiver-owned immutable identity IB-XXXXXX
canonical.Smart Note: The human-readable projection of an Intelligent Block (15-section structure)
canonical.Smart Link: Evidence-bearing navigation to the canonical Smart Note artifact; doubles as human receipt
canonical.Intelligent Event: What happened; the immutable record of an occurrence (alias: Intelligence Event [historical])
canonical.Experience Node: Human/project/domain intelligence Node; first extension tier beyond the V1 kernel
canonical.Meta-Intelligence Node: Intelligence about the system itself; feeds EVOLVE; self-improvement does not create self-authorization
canonical.Smart Node: Canonical human operating command/shorthand meaning: preserve valuable material through the existing governed Intelligent Block lifecycle. It is not a new object type, database object, graph, authority source, or tenth kernel Node.

known_discrepancies.detail: PART #2 presents a 19-contract candidate library; PART #3 says '26 contracts' but enumerates IDs 00-26 (27 contracts); the enforceable kernel spec (PART #4) requires exactly 27. Canonical count: 27 contracts (IDs 00-26), reconciled in the Contract Registry (KNOWLEDGE/NAYAPOWER-CONTRACT-REGISTRY-V1.json).

Two artifacts claim contract id 00- in .naya/contracts (00-CONTRACT-STACK-OPERATING-LAW.md and 00-NAYANET-CONSTITUTIONAL-CONTRACT-LAW.md). Flagged as ERROR in .naya/contract-library-integrity-report.json.

Older concept/glossary material used Smart Node as an alias for Naya Node. The Human Director ratified Smart Node as a human operating command mapped to the existing Intelligent Block lifecycle in PR #942/#945.
